bg.$description: Screen background, under the ambient background.

surface.$description: Opaque raised surface: dialogs, menus without glass, placeholders.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text. At least 4.5:1 on bg, surface, any glass, the ambient at its cap, and fill.

border-strong.$description: Boundary that must be seen: field, checkbox, switch track. At least 3:1.

fill.$description: Control background (chip, field, segmented track); hover of rows and quiet controls.

fill-strong.$description: Pressed rows, the current navigation item, skeletons.

track.$description: Unfilled part of a slider or progress bar.

thumb.$description: Switch thumb (off), slider thumb. At least 3:1 on border-strong over bg and surface.

accent.$description: Neutral accent (monochrome). Replaced by the content's pair in an accent region.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on the accent.

on-status.$description: Text and icons on a status colour.

glass.$description: Glass colour before tint and opacity.

tone-min.$description: Lowest CIE L* of the accent in this mode.

tone-max.$description: Highest CIE L* of the accent in this mode.

max-opacity.$description: Highest opacity of the ambient background.

cap.$description: Luminance limit of the ambient over bg, so text stays readable: at least this in light mode, at most this in dark mode.

opacity.$description: Opacity of the text colour at the centre of the neutral glow.
